DARV.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.0-0: What a trove you have here! It must have taken ages to collect all this!
DARV.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.0-1: First time I've met a young lady with such a good eye! As a reward — pick anything you like!
DARV.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.1-0: Can't I just take it all? I'm happy to pay!
DARV.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.1-1: Little miss, those coins of yours don't spend in the Spire! Have a proper look at my wares instead!
DARV.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.2-0: So many things I've never seen! Perhaps I should bring something back for my partner?
DARV.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.2-1: Every treasure here is one of a kind!
NEOW.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.0-0: We meet again, big fellow! My impression of whales isn't great, honestly... but you look far friendlier!
NEOW.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.1-0: I've been curious — where does your power to raise the dead come from? Could you teach me?
NEOW.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.1-1: The Ancients... bring... miracles... go and... meet them...
NONUPEIPE.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVI: Oh, human, how exquisitely you are dressed. Come here, let me make you even lovelier.
Thank you! You look quite elegant yourself!
Come, young lady — wear whichever piece you fancy. I promise you shall leave more graceful and splendid than you arrived.
What beautiful ornaments! Please accept this brooch as my gift in return!
OROBAS.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.0: Human! From outside? Story! Brought one?
(She tells the story of breaking a prophecy with her companions and standing against the flood...)
Will you be my companion? Spina di Rosula can send someone to tell you stories every day!
OROBAS.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.1: Spire! Treasures many! Golden human, come to seek?
Hahaha, let's just say I'm here sightseeing!
OROBAS.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.2: Story, new! Tell more! Tell more!
(She tells the story of her adventure with her companions in Simulanka...)
So strange! Cardboard blocks, come alive? Like us?
PAEL.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.0-0: A clay dragon? Wow, so cool! Here, look this way — say cheese!
PAEL.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.0-1: How wondrous... within me... is a part of me?
PAEL.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.1-0: We meet again, miss... take a part of me, and carry on...
PAEL.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.1-1: If you say that to everyone who climbs the Spire, you'll soon be carried off piece by piece, you know.
PAEL.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.1-2: (The dragon says nothing, only chuckles softly...)
TANX.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.0-1: (Navia and Tanx enjoyed a good, hearty sparring match...)
TANX.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.0-2: Fine skill! Let me grant you strength!
TANX.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.0-3: Arm yourself with blade and gun, human!
TEZCATARA.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVI: You've worked hard, child. Come, have some hot cocoa.
Heh heh, go then... safe travels...
Come to think of it, it's so warm in here... hardly like a room that never sees sunlight.
Consider it a hearth for every traveler who finds their way here, heh heh...
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_: Who are you? Where do you come from?
Is this the top of the Spire? Are you its master?
You could call it overflowing enthusiasm!
Why climb so stubbornly? What is it you seek?
You sound just like an old scholar. How about some tea and pastries instead?
VAKUU.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.0-: What a lovely young lady. I have a few ornaments that would suit you beautifully — go on, dress yourself up.
Sir, the Spina di Rosula never takes a losing deal.
VAKUU.talk.STS2_NAVIA_CHARACTER_NAVIA.1-: Well then, would you kindly sign the contract?
I read every bit of the fine print at the bottom.
My, what a shrewd customer you are...
